summary: Social.docx Issue #8 verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 3/3 pass — /api/partner/orders (list + detail) enrich items[] with pick_location + partner_product_id; /api/partner/picker/orders/{po_id} enriches lines[] with pick_location AND sorts by walking order (Bin B01 → B02 → unassigned last). Frontend Orders page shows accent-warm (rgb 252,196,76) MapPin pill for Banane B01 & Baguette B02 and grey 'No pick location — assign one under Products' fallback for Lait Frais; Picker page shows the accent-warm bordered pill (1px solid var(--ph-accent-warm)) per line, correctly ordered.

integration_issues.issue: PickerPage.jsx uses hard-coded /partner-portal/picker/${id} (line 141) and /partner-portal/picker (line 135) without the module slug. When the user clicks a queue item from /partner-portal/martbaked/picker, they are pushed to /partner-portal/picker/{id} which renders 'Unknown module'. Pre-existing routing bug — not part of Issue #8 but blocks the natural QA path. Direct URL /partner-portal/martbaked/picker/{po_id} works (verified). Fix: use useParams module slug or navigate relatively (e.g. nav(id) / nav('.')).

action_items: (Pre-existing, out of scope for Issue #8, but nice-to-have) Fix PickerPage.jsx nav('/partner-portal/picker/${id}') to include the module slug (moduleSlug from route params) so clicking a queue item from the sidebar doesn't hit 'Unknown module'.

(Minor copy diff) Review request says the picker fallback should read 'No pick location', UI actually renders 'No pick location — check with your team'. Not a functional issue — testid picker-line-location-none-<id> is correct and the message is arguably clearer for packers. Leave as-is unless the exact string is required.
critical_code_review_comments: _batch_primary_locations correctly batches all bin/shelf/rack/aisle/zone lookups in 5 IN-queries — no N+1 regression. Good.

picker_routes._pick_dict still does an N+1 session.get(MartProduct, product_id) inside the line loop to pull sku_code/ean_upc (line 108). Batching this would improve tablet load latency for big orders. Not a blocker.
PickerPage.jsx hard-codes /partner-portal/picker paths without module slug (lines 135, 141) — pre-existing routing bug surfaced during QA of Issue #8.
Walking-order sort key falls back to empty strings for missing codes — this is fine since (0, ...) tuples always sort before (1, ...). Behaviour verified with three lines (B01, B02, null).

success_rate.frontend: 100% for Issue #8 UI (Orders page + Picker detail all render correctly)

rca of the issue: N/A — feature works as designed. The only observed defect (Picker queue-item click → 'Unknown module') is a pre-existing routing bug in PickerPage.jsx (nav uses absolute paths without the module slug) and is orthogonal to Issue #8.
